    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
    refresh_token="YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN",
)

    scope="read",
)
snippet.async_client:
import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedPythonInferredAuthRefreshToken

client = AsyncSeedPythonInferredAuthRefreshToken(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
    refresh_token="YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.auth.get_token_with_refresh_token(
        refresh_token="my-refresh-token",
        grant_type="refresh_token",
        scope="read",
    )


asyncio.run(main())
